_comment: ABREL Talaja 83.7 MW wind - project configuration. Read by the data builder (dash_data.py: calendar, vocabulary, paths) and published to the page as DATA.cfg (labels, procurement columns). Never put API tokens here - they live in the gitignored scripts/vl_tokens.json / Actions secrets. This project is the one whose VisiLean tokens are pinned per feed, so it names talaja.history alongside talaja; see vl_token.py.
title: ABREL Talaja 83.7 MW — MIS Dashboard (Live)
name: ABREL Talaja 83.7 MW

calendar._comment: day 1 of the working-day axis = earliest planned start in VisiLean (21-Aug-2025; the schedule runs to 29-Oct-2026). The schedule plans work on every day of the week - 91 activities start on a Sunday and 102 on a Saturday - so no weekly off is applied, unlike the 6-day solar projects.

_baselineMode_comment: VisiLean carries baseline dates on 811 of 897 activities, so the baseline is real and rows without one are flagged un-baselined as usual.
_activityTypeFromDepartment_comment: every activity in this project is taskType 'Construction' and there is no 'Activity Type' custom field, so Engineering / Procurement - Supply / Procurement - Services / Construction are derived from the department for the EPC bifurcation and the S-curve disciplines.

departments._comment: VisiLean 'Department' custom field (its leading number is stripped) -> dashboard department key. 'Department/L3:prefix' splits a department on WBS Level 3, which is how procurement divides here: Material and Machinery & Resources are supply, the manpower service vendors are services.

_scopeRequiresWbs_comment: 43 rows in this schedule carry no WBS, no department and no weightage - 'Manpower', '60/70MT crane', 'Low Bed Trailer (Hub And TP Shifting)' and the like, VisiLean resource records sharing one placeholder month. They are not scope, so they are dropped from every count and progress figure rather than filed under Project Initiation.
_packageFromField_comment: the 'Package' custom field is a real package here (WTG Foundation works, 33kV Line, USS Works, WTG Installation & Comm., Material, ...), set on 801 of 897 activities.
_area_comment: a wind farm's areas are its turbine locations. VisiLean's location field carries them as '<package> - Location 6 to 10 [<department>]', so the first location number in the string names the area; activities that cover a range land on the range's first location.
_steps_comment: the procurement pipeline's columns, matched against the activity name. This schedule names procurement steps plainly - 'PR', 'RFQ Floating', 'Comparative Statement', 'PO Release', 'Material Dispatch', 'Material Receipt at Site' - so the five stages read straight off the names.
_stepMatch_comment: this schedule names a procurement step after its vendor - 'Apar - PO', 'Apar - MDCC', 'Galaxy - Material receipt at site' - so a step key has to END the name. Matching anywhere in the name would count 'Pole Erection' as a PO.
_steps2_comment: PR raised -> PO released -> MDCC (despatch clearance) -> Material receipt at site. This project has no separate technical bid evaluation, so the MDCC gate takes that column.
_statSteps_comment: the statutory milestone chips are NTPC's (CEA, self-COD, SLDC); this project's approvals are GEDA, STU and CEA under Statutory, tracked in that department rather than as fixed chips.
_sync_comment: the workflow that keeps this dashboard fed; the page asks GitHub about it only when a build is old enough to question (checkSyncHealth)
